units.source_text: 对于老师这番言明，我耿耿于怀。

en.t: I brooded over this declaration from the teacher.

units.source_text: 虽说这种宣告是头一次，

en.t: Although this was the first time such a declaration had been made,

units.source_text: 但我早就预感到会有这种宣告，是有思想准备的。

en.t: I had long sensed that such a declaration would come, and I was mentally prepared for it.

units.source_text: 所以我听到这种宣告时，并不感到是个晴天霹雳。

en.t: So when I heard it, I did not feel as though it were a bolt from the blue.

units.source_text: 再说，事到如今，大吃一惊或狼狈周章都无济于事。

en.t: Besides, at this point, being shocked or thrown into confusion would have done no good.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我还是喜欢这样认为：

en.t: Even so, I preferred to think of it this way:

units.source_text: 我自己所以出走，是由于受老师这番话的触发，一时冲动之下采取的行为。

en.t: My own running away was an act I took on impulse, triggered by those words from the teacher.
